theme_strategy.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Swiss Brutalist for Developer Tools)
theme_strategy.vibe: Sleek, minimalist, technical, fast, and authoritative.

rules.headings: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), use font-light or font-black for extreme contrast, never use generic 'Inter'.
rules.data_tables: Use IBM Plex Mono for table data (Filename, Status, API Keys input) to enforce a technical, code-editor feel.
rules.hierarchy_gap: Maximum heading size text-4xl. Do not exceed for this utility app.

rules.contrast: Ensure pure monochrome emphasis with quiet chrome. Colors exist only to indicate state (Status success/error).
rules.borders: Use 1px border-white/10 everywhere instead of shadows. No soft UI shadows.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Grid Borders (Technical Look)'. Expose the skeleton. Containers should have border-collapse style layouts.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this data-heavy utility app. Use Solid flat backgrounds with crisp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: High contrast inversion. e.g., Hovering on a border might turn it from white/10 to white/30.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Primary button must be Stark White background with Black text. Stop button must be stark Red.
components.inputs: API Keys Textarea must look like a terminal/code editor (IBM Plex Mono, flat dark bg, 1px border). No resize handle.
components.table: Data-table-first layout. border-collapse, dense padding (p-2), mono font for status and filename. No generic Shadcn cards—use flat rectangular structures.
components.progress_bar: Minimalist 1px or 2px high line. No chunky rounded progress bars.
components.panels: Card stacks with surface elevation—layered background steps instead of drop shadows.

grids_and_layouts.page_structure: Top heavy control panel (Bento grid style) and bottom-heavy data table.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Control Panel should use a grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 system. API Keys (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4), Options (col-span-12 md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-4), Actions (col-span-12 md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense inside tables (gap-2, p-2) but generous between major sections (py-12).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left alignment for all labels, inputs, and tabular data.

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle row highlight when processing. Processing state indicator (e.g., pulsing dot or mono spinning text).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease. NO transition: all.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Light text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-processing-button').

image_urls.description: Abstract technical grid texture to be used at very low opacity (e.g., 5-10%) as a background for the empty state before a folder is selected.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, crisp look suitable for dense dashboards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required font families: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono (e.g. via Google Fonts in index.html).
Build a single-page dashboard layout. Divide into Top Control Panel and Bottom Results Table.
API Keys textarea should accept multiple lines and look like a code block.
The Results Table must update live. Use a clean border-collapse design.
Implement the 'Very simple options interface' requirement by using collapsible sections (e.g. Radix Accordion) for Advanced Prompt Settings.
Follow the Dark Mode Only theme. Use Tailwind classes like bg-[#09090B] and text-[#FAFAFA] or override globals in CSS.
DO NOT use Card wrappers for everything. Use raw divs with border-white/10 to create a flat, technical grid look.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered background colors (Surface elevation), NOT shadows in dark mode.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container. Left-align text naturally.
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners for this technical tool) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
